# `test_full_backend_account_is_present` fails on clean `origin/main`

Found while running CI's real selection for [rebar:bf31-fd55-d28d-4b7a].

    pytest -m "not integration and not external" -n 4 --dist worksteal -q
    -> 1 failed, 10440 passed, 46 skipped in 572.67s
    FAILED tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py::test_full_backend_account_is_present
    AssertionError: assert 'metric' in {'opengrep': {'ran': 1, 'skipped': 5, ...

**Confirmed pre-existing, not caused by that change.** Re-run with the bf31 change stashed on a
clean tree at `origin/main` `68ae305cef`: still `exit 1`, identical assertion. Filed rather than
absorbed so it is not silently attributed to an unrelated change later.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] the root cause of the missing `metric` backend entry in the coverage reconstruction is
      identified (a genuinely absent backend account vs. a stale expectation in the test)
- [ ] `pytest -m "not integration and not external"` is green on `main`
- [ ] whichever side was wrong is corrected — if the expectation is stale the test is updated, if
      the accounting is wrong the source is fixed; not the test weakened to pass
data.title: test_full_backend_account_is_present fails on clean origin/main (pre-existing CI red)
